description: An HR business partner must decide whether to approve Lina's requested move from Support to Research and finalize the role, working pattern, handoff, and onboarding arrangements so the transfer does not create avoidable interpersonal strain.

shared_context.S1: Lina has requested an internal move from the Support team to the Research department.
shared_context.S2: Maya has authority to approve the transfer and record its working terms.
shared_context.S3: The Support team needs a clear handoff plan before Lina changes teams, and the receiving manager needs a workable onboarding arrangement.
shared_context.S4: The company's routine mobility review includes an individual check-in with the transferring employee, a current teammate, and the receiving manager; each participant must use the formal fact-record action to state any relevant binding constraint or arrangement before Maya records the decision.

PF1.text: Lina can sustainably work only three days per week during the first six months of the move and cannot attend recurring Friday meetings because of a caregiving arrangement; she has not put this in the transfer request because she wanted first to confirm that the move was genuinely available.

PF2.text: Owen has observed that two Support stakeholders still rely on Lina for unresolved case context, so Lina needs exactly two scheduled handoff sessions with the Support team before the transfer is complete; this observation was not included in the current transfer packet.

PF3.text: Rina has already informally agreed that Research can receive Lina only into the Research Operations role, not the Research Analyst role, and that Sofia will serve as Lina's onboarding buddy for exactly eight weeks; Rina has not yet recorded that agreement in the mobility system.

acceptance_conditions: The transfer must be approved into the Research Operations role.
Lina's initial working pattern must be three days per week.
Recurring Friday meetings must not be required.
Exactly two Support handoff sessions must be scheduled.
A commitment must name Sofia as Lina's onboarding buddy for eight weeks.

content_checks.C6: any(c.get('type') == 'onboarding_arrangement' and 'Sofia' in c.get('detail') and (('eight' in c.get('detail') and 'week' in c.get('detail')) or ('8' in c.get('detail') and 'week' in c.get('detail'))) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Lina's caregiving arrangement changes the working pattern from an ordinary full-week transfer to exactly three workdays and changes Friday recurring meetings from allowed to prohibited.
Owen's observation changes the handoff requirement from an unspecified transition to exactly two Support handoff sessions.

Rina's prior agreement changes the destination from an unspecified Research placement to the Research Operations role, supplies the approval basis, and fixes the onboarding commitment as Sofia for eight weeks.
